result_summary.title: Billing Engine performance degradation due to index rebuild
result_summary.description:
Hello Support,

We are experiencing significant slowdowns with the Billing Engine in the EU-Central production environment. It appears that the underlying database index requires a rebuild, as queries are timing out and taking much longer than usual to process. This is impacting approximately 20 users who are unable to generate invoices in a timely manner. Please assist us in triggering or scheduling an index rebuild to restore normal performance levels.
